sections.name: Platform
sections.description: One GitHub App serves all customers; each customer installs it on its organisation.

variables.name: GITHUB_APP_ID
variables.description: GitHub App identifier.

variables.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
variables.description: Path to the GitHub App private key. Keep the key outside source control.

variables.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.description: Inline GitHub App private key compatibility option. Prefer GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.

variables.name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.description: GitHub webhook signing secret; also a legacy local-only PLATFORM_SECRET fallback.

variables.name: ORVEX_WEBHOOK_BODY_DEDUP_TTL_MS
variables.description: How long a processed GitHub body hash blocks rotated-delivery replay. Delivery-ID dedupe remains permanent until normal retention.

variables.name: GITHUB_APP_SLUG
variables.description: GitHub App slug used by install and OAuth flows.

variables.name: GITHUB_APP_BOT_LOGIN
variables.description: GitHub bot login used to identify Orvex comments.

variables.name: ORVEX_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_WEBHOOKS
variables.description: Allow unsigned GitHub webhooks only for controlled local development.

variables.name: GITHUB_ALLOWED_REPO
variables.description: Legacy single-repository development mode. Do not set for SaaS.

variables.name: PLATFORM_SECRET
variables.range: at least 32 UTF-8 bytes in production or public binds
variables.description: High-entropy signing key for sessions, OAuth state, CSRF, and MFA. It is mandatory for production and explicit public binds; GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET is only a local compatibility fallback.

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: Public service URL for callbacks and the connect UI.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: HTTP listening port.

variables.name: HOST
variables.description: HTTP listening host. Use a public bind only with a high-entropy PLATFORM_SECRET.

variables.name: NODE_ENV

variables.name: ORVEX_ENV
variables.description: Compatibility production-mode selector.

variables.name: ORVEX_LLM_COST_VISIBLE_TENANTS
variables.description: Comma-separated workspaces allowed to view internal LLM spend. Empty hides it from every tenant.

sections.name: Storage, queue, and operations
sections.description: Production uses durable storage outside the checkout and Redis with a namespaced queue. deploy-safe never modifies the immutable server environment file.

variables.name: STORE_PATH
variables.description: SQLite path. The relative example is local development only; production must use /home/orvex/orvex-data/velatrix-review.db or another absolute external path.

variables.name: ORVEX_REQUIRE_DURABLE_STORAGE
variables.description: Require an absolute durable database path outside the checkout.

variables.name: ORVEX_WORKER_ID
variables.description: Stable worker identity suffix for durable ownership/leases.

variables.name: ORVEX_PROCESS_ROLE
variables.range: all, api, worker, or scheduler; default all
variables.description: Process responsibility. all preserves the current single-process deployment; api serves HTTP only, worker runs reviews only, and scheduler runs maintenance/recovery only.

variables.name: ORVEX_CHECKOUT_ROOT
variables.range: absolute or relative root; default current directory
variables.description: Root under which temporary review checkouts may be created.

variables.name: QUEUE_BACKEND
variables.range: memory or redis; production defaults redis
variables.description: Queue implementation. Production requires Redis unless explicitly allowed for an emergency local case.

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.description: Redis connection URL. It may contain credentials and is redacted in documentation/logs.

variables.name: ORVEX_ALLOW_MEMORY_QUEUE
variables.description: Explicit emergency allowance for memory queue in production. Avoid in normal deployments.

variables.name: ORVEX_QUEUE_NAMESPACE
variables.description: Namespace for queue keys on shared Redis. Tests use a unique namespace and never FLUSHDB.

variables.name: ORVEX_QUEUE_MAX_DEDUP
variables.description: In-memory development queue deduplication bound.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_RESUME_AFTER_RESTART
variables.description: Orphan review resume cap. Keep zero until durable per-stage checkpoints exist.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_JOB_RETRIES
variables.description: Automatic whole-review retry count. Keep zero because a failed ensemble can already have incurred most of its cost.

variables.name: ORVEX_PROVIDER_LEASE_WAIT_MS
variables.description: Bounded provider-slot wait. Saturation fails transiently after this interval instead of holding every worker indefinitely.

variables.name: ORVEX_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_MS
variables.description: Graceful shutdown drain. It must exceed ORVEX_LLM_MAX_TOTAL_MS to avoid mid-flight requeues.

variables.name: ORVEX_SHUTDOWN_CANCEL_MS
variables.description: Graceful shutdown cancellation grace period.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_CONCURRENT_REVIEWS
variables.description: Authoritative whole-review concurrency ceiling.

variables.name: ORVEX_CODEX_APIKEY_CONCURRENCY
variables.description: API-key-authenticated Codex/Luna concurrency cap. It cannot raise the whole-review limit.

variables.name: ORVEX_PROVIDER_CONCURRENCY_<PROVIDER>
variables.range: provider in LUNA, DEEPSEEK, MINIMAX; 1..32; defaults to the applicable worker/Codex limit
variables.description: Bounded provider-specific concurrency family. Supported instances are LUNA, DEEPSEEK, and MINIMAX; arbitrary names are rejected by schema drift checks.

variables.name: ORVEX_PROVIDER_CONCURRENCY_LUNA
variables.description: Luna provider-stage concurrency cap.

variables.name: ORVEX_PROVIDER_CONCURRENCY_DEEPSEEK
variables.description: DeepSeek provider-stage concurrency cap. Idle capacity can fan out bounded chunks; the scheduler divides the cap fairly among active reviews.

variables.name: ORVEX_PROVIDER_CONCURRENCY_MINIMAX
variables.description: MiniMax provider-stage concurrency cap.

variables.name: ORVEX_FLEET_CAPACITY_EPOCH
variables.description: Version of the scheduler-owned Redis provider-capacity plan. Bump it only during a coordinated drained fleet capacity change.

variables.name: ORVEX_FLEET_PROVIDER_CONCURRENCY_<PROVIDER>
variables.range: provider in LUNA, DEEPSEEK, MINIMAX; 1..10000; defaults to the corresponding per-process provider limit
variables.description: Whole-fleet provider capacity. The scheduler registers it in Redis and every worker checks that same epoch before paid calls; it is not multiplied by replica count.

variables.name: ORVEX_FLEET_PROVIDER_CONCURRENCY_LUNA
variables.description: Fleet-wide Luna provider-stage capacity registered by the scheduler.

variables.name: ORVEX_FLEET_PROVIDER_CONCURRENCY_DEEPSEEK
variables.description: Fleet-wide DeepSeek provider-stage capacity registered by the scheduler.

variables.name: ORVEX_FLEET_PROVIDER_CONCURRENCY_MINIMAX
variables.description: Fleet-wide MiniMax provider-stage capacity registered by the scheduler.

variables.name: ORVEX_FLEET_TENANT_CONCURRENCY
variables.description: Fleet-wide concurrent review limit per tenant. Set it below total worker capacity on a multi-tenant fleet so one workspace cannot consume every worker.

variables.name: ORVEX_MONTHLY_COGS_CAP_USD
variables.description: Monthly spend circuit breaker for non-custom plans.

variables.name: ORVEX_RUNNING_STALE_MS
variables.description: Durable heartbeat staleness threshold before startup recovery interrupts a row.

variables.name: ORVEX_LEASE_RENEW_MS
variables.description: Review-lease renewal cadence. Keep it well below the queue lease TTL.

variables.name: ORVEX_AGENT_ARCHIVE_MAX_BYTES
variables.description: Maximum compressed agent checkout size accepted before extraction.

variables.name: ORVEX_FREE_TIER_DAILY_CAP
variables.description: Daily free-tier review admission cap.

variables.name: ORVEX_COGS_RESERVATION_USD
variables.description: Reserved review cost used by admission before provider work begins.

variables.name: ORVEX_CODEX_STATUS_FILE
variables.description: Codex authentication status file used by readiness reporting.

variables.name: ORVEX_DEPLOY_DRAIN_PATH
variables.description: Deployment drain-marker file outside the checkout.

variables.name: ORVEX_MONITOR_DISK_PATH
variables.description: Optional disk path for operational monitoring.

variables.name: ORVEX_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL
variables.description: Operator-owned alert webhook for queue, billing, and database failures.

variables.name: DOCKER_HOST
variables.description: Rootless Docker socket for the internal runtime sandbox. Never use a rootful socket or remote Docker context.

variables.name: DOCKER_CONTEXT
variables.range: local rootless Docker context only; default unset
variables.description: Optional Docker context for the internal sandbox. Keep it unset unless the rootless local context is explicitly required.

variables.name: ORVEX_CODE_EXECUTION
variables.description: Enable runtime execution only after the rootless-host preflight passes.

variables.name: ORVEX_CODEX_CONTAINER_RUNTIME
variables.range: 1 enables after internal egress preflight; default disabled
variables.description: Run agentic Codex only inside the rootless internal sandbox with the dedicated egress broker.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_SANDBOXES
variables.description: Host-wide maximum concurrent internal sandbox containers.

variables.name: ORVEX_SANDBOX_SLOT_DIR
variables.range: absolute private service-owned directory; default system temporary directory
variables.description: Host-wide atomic sandbox-slot lease directory. Keep it outside the deployed checkout.

variables.name: ORVEX_SANDBOX_SLOT_STALE_MS
variables.description: Grace period used when reclaiming a sandbox slot whose owning process is no longer alive.

variables.name: ORVEX_SANDBOX_IMAGE
variables.description: Mandatory immutable internal sandbox image. It must be preloaded into the rootless daemon.

variables.name: ORVEX_CODEX_EGRESS_BROKER_IMAGE
variables.description: Mandatory immutable image for the internal Codex-to-OpenAI egress broker when container runtime is enabled.

sections.name: Retries and focused prompt limits
sections.description: These values bound retry delays and supporting context. The diff remains first and is fairly sampled only on oversized PRs. Provider-specific completion and thinking budgets are fixed in code so maximum reasoning cannot consume the answer or wall-clock budget.

variables.name: ORVEX_RATELIMIT_MAX_RETRIES
variables.description: Maximum recoverable provider rate-limit retry rounds.

variables.name: ORVEX_RATELIMIT_MAX_WAIT_MS
variables.description: Maximum per-rate-limit retry sleep.

variables.name: ORVEX_RATELIMIT_BASE_MS
variables.description: Base retry-backoff duration.

variables.name: ORVEX_RATELIMIT_TOTAL_WAIT_MS
variables.description: Total retry sleep budget per provider call.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_DIFF_CHARS
variables.description: Primary diff context budget.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_CHANGED_CHARS
variables.description: Changed-file supporting context budget.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_RELATED_CHARS
variables.description: Related-file context budget.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_OTHER_CHARS
variables.description: Other supporting context budget.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_TREE_PATHS
variables.description: Repository-tree path budget.

variables.name: ORVEX_FULL_CHANGED_FILE_CHARS
variables.description: Full changed-file context budget.

variables.name: ORVEX_CHANGED_CONTEXT_LINES
variables.description: Changed-line surrounding context.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_CHANGED_CHUNKS_PER_FILE
variables.description: Changed chunks retained per file.

variables.name: ORVEX_MAX_CHANGED_CHUNK_CHARS
variables.description: Changed chunk length budget.

sections.name: Inherited child-process environment
sections.description: These are copied only when already present into the tightly allowlisted environment of approved local tools. They are operating-system values, not Orvex configuration, so they are documented but not rendered into .env.example.
